keyPoints.en: Rhyming words sound alike: star–are, toes–nose.
keyPoints.hi: तुक वाले शब्द मिलते-जुलते हैं: star–are, toes–nose।

problem.en: In "Twinkle Twinkle Little Star", what is twinkling?
problem.hi: "Twinkle Twinkle Little Star" में क्या चमक रहा है?
"toes" से किस शब्द की तुक मिलती है?

steps.en: Head, shoulders, knees and toes … eyes and ears and mouth and nose.
steps.hi: Head, shoulders, knees and toes … eyes and ears and mouth and nose।

question.en: In "Johny Johny", what was Johny eating?
question.hi: "Johny Johny" में जॉनी क्या खा रहा था?

question.en: Where is the star in the rhyme?

answer.en: Up above the world so high, in the sky

question.en: Touch your knees! Which rhyme has knees?
question.hi: घुटने छुओ! किस कविता में घुटने आते हैं?

intro.en: Rhymes are short songs. We sing them with actions. "Head, shoulders, knees and toes" — touch each part as you sing!
intro.hi: कविताएँ छोटे गीत होती हैं। इन्हें हाव-भाव के साथ गाते हैं। "Head, shoulders, knees and toes" — गाते हुए हर अंग छुओ!
